name: Karuppaswamy Moola Mantra: the Shivaputra formula
text:
ॐ क्रूं असिताङ्गाय महावीर पराक्रमाय गदाधराय धूम्रनेत्राय
दंष्ट्राकरालाय मालाधराय नीलाम्बरदाय सर्वपापघ्ने
सर्वभयघ्ने शिवपुत्राय क्रुद्धाय कृपाकराय स्वाहा ॥
meaning: AUM and Krūṃ: salutations to the dark-limbed one, the great hero of mighty valour, bearer of the mace, smoky-eyed and fierce in appearance, wearer of a garland and dark-blue garments; destroyer of wrongdoing and fear; son of Shiva; fierce, yet a source of compassion. Svāhā marks the offering.
purpose: A fierce protective invocation of Karuppaswamy. The wording combines heroic, guardian and compassionate qualities and names him as Shivaputra.
supports: Courage; protection as a devotional intention; facing fear; strengthening boundaries; remembering that fierceness and compassion can coexist.
when: As a devotional recitation if this is the form that resonates with you. Follow the pronunciation and recitation customs of your source or local tradition where possible.
note: Published online as Karuppaswamy’s moola mantra. It does not establish that every Karuppar shrine uses this exact formula, and it should not be labelled the one universal Vettai Karuppar mantra.
source: Published devotional text (AstroBhava, Karuppasamy mantra page), as cited in the client library
